scope: Exact 51 otherCriticalHigh input records; primary advisory metadata and compatible published tool graphs. This is not a full security audit or current deployment acceptance.

GHSA-5j98-mcp5-4vw2.summary: glob CLI: Command injection via -c/--cmd executes matches with shell:true
GHSA-5j98-mcp5-4vw2.triggerInput: Running glob CLI -c/--cmd on attacker-controlled filenames containing shell metacharacters; ordinary glob library calls are outside this advisory.

GHSA-379q-355j-w6rj.summary: pnpm v10+ Bypass "Dependency lifecycle scripts execution disabled by default"
GHSA-379q-355j-w6rj.triggerInput: Installing a git-hosted dependency with prepare/prepublish/prepack scripts; fetch preparation bypasses the dependency build allowlist.

GHSA-2phv-j68v-wwqx.summary: pnpm vulnerable to Command Injection via environment variable substitution
GHSA-2phv-j68v-wwqx.triggerInput: pnpm loads a tokenHelper setting after npmrc environment substitution; attacker controls substituted values and shell interpretation.

GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm.summary: braces vulnerable to stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested patterns
GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm.triggerInput: Compiling/expanding deeply nested attacker-controlled brace patterns; recursive AST walkers lack depth guards and exhaust the process stack.

GHSA-23hp-3jrh-7fpw.summary: node-tar: Decompression/parse DoS via unlimited input
GHSA-23hp-3jrh-7fpw.triggerInput: Extracting an untrusted compressed TAR whose expansion or entry count consumes disk/CPU beyond intended bounds.

GHSA-mwp4-54f8-5fhr.summary: ip-address: Address4 decodes leading-zero octets as decimal while resolvers decode them as octal, allowing SSRF and trust-boundary bypass
GHSA-mwp4-54f8-5fhr.triggerInput: A caller uses Address4 checks as a network trust/SSRF boundary then resolves a leading-zero octet address with a stack that interprets it as octal.

GHSA-8x88-c5mf-7j5w.summary: node-tar: Negative tar entry size causes infinite loop in archive replace
GHSA-8x88-c5mf-7j5w.triggerInput: Calling tar.replace on an existing attacker-controlled archive containing a checksum-valid negative base-256 entry size; this is the archive replacement scan.

GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895.summary: brace-expansion: DoS via unbounded intermediate arrays, bypassing the CVE-2026-14257 mitigation
GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895.triggerInput: Expanding untrusted comma alternatives or wide padded sequences; intermediate expansion arrays exceed the intended output-length bound.

GHSA-34x7-hfp2-rc4v.summary: node-tar Vulnerable to Arbitrary File Creation/Overwrite via Hardlink Path Traversal
GHSA-34x7-hfp2-rc4v.triggerInput: Extracting an untrusted TAR hardlink with a traversal linkpath; path check and hardlink creation use different base directories.

GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg.summary: brace-expansion: DoS via unbounded expansion length causing an out-of-memory process crash
GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg.triggerInput: Expanding an untrusted chain of brace groups with limited result count but unbounded output length; process memory is exhausted.

GHSA-vq4v-j7r6-jq4m.summary: pnpm: A tarball dependency's manifest `name` escapes node_modules → arbitrary file write/overwrite on install
GHSA-vq4v-j7r6-jq4m.triggerInput: pnpm install imports a tarball package with a traversal-shaped scoped manifest name outside node_modules, including with ignore-scripts.

GHSA-c59q-g84q-2gj5.summary: pnpm: Virtual store linker path traversal via unvalidated depPath name in lockfileToDepGraph
GHSA-c59q-g84q-2gj5.triggerInput: pnpm install reads attacker-controlled depPath/package names from a lockfile and joins them into virtual-store import paths without containment.

GHSA-7r86-cg39-jmmj.summary: minimatch has ReDoS: matchOne() combinatorial backtracking via multiple non-adjacent GLOBSTAR segments
GHSA-7r86-cg39-jmmj.triggerInput: Matching an untrusted pattern with several nonadjacent GLOBSTAR segments against a path; recursive matchOne backtracks combinatorially.

GHSA-3ppc-4f35-3m26.summary: minimatch has a ReDoS via repeated wildcards with non-matching literal in pattern
GHSA-3ppc-4f35-3m26.triggerInput: Matching an untrusted glob with repeated wildcards and an absent trailing literal; generated regex backtracks exponentially.

GHSA-hwx4-2j3j-g496.summary: pnpm: Transitive dependency alias path traversal allows project path override via symlink replacement
GHSA-hwx4-2j3j-g496.triggerInput: Installing registry package metadata with a traversal-shaped transitive alias; dependency linking replaces project paths with attacker package symlinks even with ignore-scripts.

GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp.summary: http-cache-semantics max-stale handling can disclose cross-user cached responses
GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp.triggerInput: Reported trigger: a retained shared-cache response with Set-Cookie/proxy-revalidate is reused after a requester sends max-stale. Maintainer disputes this security interpretation; private cache directives are material.

GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh.summary: js-yaml: maxTotalMergeKeys does not limit CPU use for empty merge sources
GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh.triggerInput: Parsing untrusted YAML with repeated merge sequences of empty mappings; empty sources evade the merge-key CPU budget.

GHSA-r292-9mhp-454m.summary: node-tar: Uncontrolled recursion in mapHas/filesFilter allows uncatchable stack-overflow DoS via crafted long-path tar with member selection
GHSA-r292-9mhp-454m.triggerInput: Listing/extracting selected TAR members from untrusted input with very deep GNU/PAX long paths; mapHas recurses before extraction depth guards.

GHSA-23c5-xmqv-rm74.summary: minimatch ReDoS: nested *() extglobs generate catastrophically backtracking regular expressions
GHSA-23c5-xmqv-rm74.triggerInput: Matching attacker-controlled nested star/plus extglob patterns against a nonmatching input; default minimatch API, without special options.

GHSA-c2c7-rcm5-vvqj.summary: Picomatch has a ReDoS vulnerability via extglob quantifiers
GHSA-c2c7-rcm5-vvqj.triggerInput: Matching untrusted glob patterns with nested or repeated extglob quantifiers; regex execution can consume excessive CPU.

GHSA-7vhp-vf5g-r2fw.summary: pnpm Has Lockfile Integrity Bypass that Allows Remote Dynamic Dependencies
GHSA-7vhp-vf5g-r2fw.triggerInput: Installing an HTTP/git tarball dependency whose lockfile omits integrity; the remote server changes content after the lock is committed.

GHSA-rxhj-4m44-96r4.summary: pnpm Vulnerable to Arbitrary File Write/Delete via Malicious Patch File (Path Traversal)
GHSA-rxhj-4m44-96r4.triggerInput: pnpm install applies a repository-controlled patch containing traversal file paths; writes/deletes occur outside the package directory.

GHSA-qffp-2rhf-9h96.summary: tar has Hardlink Path Traversal via Drive-Relative Linkpath
GHSA-qffp-2rhf-9h96.triggerInput: Extracting an untrusted TAR hardlink entry with a drive-relative target; the link can escape cwd.

GHSA-8qq5-rm4j-mr97.summary: node-tar is Vulnerable to Arbitrary File Overwrite and Symlink Poisoning via Insufficient Path Sanitization
GHSA-8qq5-rm4j-mr97.triggerInput: Extracting an untrusted TAR with hardlink or symbolic-link linkpath escaping cwd despite default preservePaths=false.

GHSA-c475-qrg2-pj4r.summary: basic-ftp: Quadratic-time CPU denial of service in Client.list() Unix directory-listing parser (RE_LINE backtracking)
GHSA-c475-qrg2-pj4r.triggerInput: Calling basic-ftp Client.list on an attacker-controlled FTP server returning a crafted Unix listing line; the listing parser blocks the event loop.

GHSA-6j4f-fj2g-mc7p.summary: brace-expansion: DoS via uncontrolled recursion in parseCommaParts causing stack exhaustion
GHSA-6j4f-fj2g-mc7p.triggerInput: Expanding untrusted brace patterns that drive deep parseCommaParts recursion and exhaust the process stack.

GHSA-qhr7-859c-m2p7.summary: brace-expansion: DoS via uncontrolled recursion on nested brace groups causing stack exhaustion
GHSA-qhr7-859c-m2p7.triggerInput: Expanding deeply nested untrusted brace sets; remaining nested-group recursion exhausts the stack despite output limits.

GHSA-w4pp-8pjf-rmxw.summary: pacote is vulnerable to Denial of Service (DoS) via the addGitSha function
GHSA-w4pp-8pjf-rmxw.triggerInput: Processing an attacker-controlled git rawSpec with pacote addGitSha; regex/string replacement consumes excessive CPU.

GHSA-3jxr-9vmj-r5cp.summary: brace-expansion: DoS via exponential-time expansion of consecutive non-expanding {} groups
GHSA-3jxr-9vmj-r5cp.triggerInput: Expanding an untrusted pattern containing consecutive nonexpanding brace groups; redundant recursion causes exponential CPU use.

GHSA-w466-c33r-3gjp.summary: pnpm: Project env lockfile can short-circuit package-manager resolution and execute lockfile-selected pnpm bytes
GHSA-w466-c33r-3gjp.triggerInput: Automatic pnpm version switching trusts repository-committed packageManagerDependencies in the env lockfile and executes its selected package-manager bytes.

GHSA-r6q2-hw4h-h46w.summary: Race Condition in node-tar Path Reservations via Unicode Ligature Collisions on macOS APFS
GHSA-r6q2-hw4h-h46w.triggerInput: Parallel extraction of colliding Unicode paths on a case/normalization-insensitive filesystem, demonstrated on macOS APFS; path reservations do not serialize the collision.

GHSA-83g3-92jg-28cx.summary: Arbitrary File Read/Write via Hardlink Target Escape Through Symlink Chain in node-tar Extraction
GHSA-83g3-92jg-28cx.triggerInput: Extracting an untrusted TAR hardlink through a symlink chain that escapes the extraction root.

GHSA-9ppj-qmqm-q256.summary: node-tar Symlink Path Traversal via Drive-Relative Linkpath
GHSA-9ppj-qmqm-q256.triggerInput: Extracting an untrusted TAR symbolic-link entry with a drive-relative target; the link can escape cwd.

GHSA-gj8w-mvpf-x27x.summary: pnpm: Repository-controlled configDependencies can select a pacquet native install engine
GHSA-gj8w-mvpf-x27x.triggerInput: Repository-controlled configDependencies select pacquet/@pnpm/pacquet as an install engine before command dispatch; native code can run even before ordinary dependency install.

GHSA-52v5-jr5w-gjxr.summary: sigstore's `certificateOIDs` verification constraints are silently dropped and never enforced
GHSA-52v5-jr5w-gjxr.triggerInput: Calling sigstore.verify/createVerifier with certificateOIDs as a required certificate policy; supplied OID constraints are discarded.

GHSA-5wx6-mg75-v57r.summary: pnpm: Manifest identity spoof satisfies allowBuilds and runs attacker lifecycle
GHSA-5wx6-mg75-v57r.triggerInput: Install/build approval uses dependency identity normalization; distinct opaque git/URL/tarball/file locators can collide with an approved allowBuilds key.

GHSA-5p4m-2wfm-xmqj.summary: JS-YAML: Quadratic CPU consumption in !!omap resolution (3.x and 4.x) — CVE-2026-59870 fix not backported
GHSA-5p4m-2wfm-xmqj.triggerInput: Parsing untrusted YAML containing a large !!omap; default schema uniqueness checks formerly scanned a growing array.

GHSA-72r4-9c5j-mj57.summary: pnpm: `patch-remove` could delete project-selected files outside the patches directory
GHSA-72r4-9c5j-mj57.triggerInput: Executing pnpm patch-remove on a repository-controlled patchedDependencies path outside the intended patches directory.

GHSA-fr4h-3cph-29xv.summary: pnpm: Hoisted install imports lockfile alias outside node_modules
GHSA-fr4h-3cph-29xv.triggerInput: pnpm hoisted install reads an attacker-controlled lockfile alias containing traversal or reserved names and imports files outside node_modules.

GHSA-qrv3-253h-g69c.summary: pnpm: Path traversal in configDependencies env lockfile allows symlink creation outside node_modules/.pnpm-config
GHSA-qrv3-253h-g69c.triggerInput: pnpm install reads a traversal-shaped config dependency name in the env lockfile and creates a symlink outside node_modules/.pnpm-config.
